verdict.rationale: Loading and switching models is a fair question for an inference server, so the axis applies, but the pack never documents hot-loading or switching base models on a running server. The only related item is multi-LoRA support (vllm-docs-10), which serves adapters on one base model. That is an adjacent feature, and the pack gives no evidence of runtime load or unload, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server
